corpus: 40 official EN 16931 example instances (ubl/examples + cii/examples, ConnectingEurope repo, raw.githubusercontent)
method: extraction: ElementTree stdlib, paths read from the files (two of my own extraction bugs found and fixed mid-campaign: LegalMonetaryTotal double-count in UBL BT-109, header+category TaxAmount double-count in UBL BT-110 — both produced fake CONTRADICTEDs that were attributed to the extractor before any headline). verdicts: POST /api/v1/batch tool=invoice_validate_totals, Decimal components, sha256 per receipt.

finding_huf.attribution: ISO-4217 assigns 0 minor units to HUF; the example rounds to whole forints (correct in practice), the official Schematron hardcodes 2 decimals (currency-blind). The example and the standard's own formula disagree, by the standard's own arithmetic.

not_assessable_reason: CII examples carry category RATES but not per-category TaxAmount/BasisAmount; BR-CO-14 cannot be evaluated on them — named, not guessed.
